summary: Tian'an Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes balance sheet, income statement, cash flow data, segment information, and related-party disclosures. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is mentioned. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer; no event triggering classification under special situations is present. It is a standard regulatory filing.
